solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Drugs cupboards — be given label to put on such

indicators.note: the first pieces are placed on, i.e. in front of, the cupboards in this across entry

parts.note: a tab is a small label attached to something
lockers are small lockable cupboards

explanation.surface: Someone storing medicines is told to stick labels on the cupboards.
explanation.walkthrough: 'such' just points back to the cupboards and gives no letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Beta-blockers are a class of medicines used for heart conditions and anxiety, so they are drugs.

clue.text: Fail when beginning to talk nonsense

parts.note: to bomb is to fail badly, as a show that flops
as can mean when, as in 'as I left'

indicators.note: only the opening letter of the word talk is wanted, its beginning

explanation.surface: A speaker flops as soon as they start spouting rubbish.
explanation.definitionFit: Bombast is pompous, inflated language with little substance, so empty nonsense.

clue.text: Stock report a Londoner's got hold of

indicators.note: the words report a Londoner's have the letters in their grip, held across the word breaks

explanation.surface: A news story says some Londoner has acquired shares.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stock' looks financial but it is the card-game sense.
explanation.definitionFit: In card games the talon is the pile of undealt cards left after the deal, also called the stock.

clue.text: City bankrupt? Accusation (not good) must be admitted

indicators.note: the trimmed accusation has to be let into the word for bankrupt

parts.note: bust means bankrupt, as in a firm going bust

indicators.note: the letter G, short for good, is dropped from the word

parts.note: a charge is a formal accusation

explanation.surface: A whole city faces a charge of going broke.
explanation.definitionFit: Bucharest is the capital city of Romania.

clue.text: Name of American singer, one who gave many a lift

definitions.meaning: ... Redding was an American soul singer

definitions.text: one who gave many a lift
definitions.meaning: Elisha ... founded the elevator company whose safety lifts carry millions

explanation.surface: An American singer known for giving people rides.
explanation.definitionFit: Both the soul singer Redding and the elevator pioneer Elisha share this name, so each sense fits.

clue.text: See less than enthusiastic sweetheart faint?

indicators.note: the word for enthusiastic falls short of its full length, losing its final letter

parts.note: keen means enthusiastic
a lover is a sweetheart

explanation.surface: A lukewarm sweetheart swoons on cue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'See' is only a link word here; 'less than' cuts the last letter from KEEN to leave KEE.
explanation.definitionFit: To keel over is an idiom for collapsing or fainting, like a boat capsizing.

clue.text: Old coat to be shortened, taken up? That would be capital!

indicators.note: in a down entry, taken up means the letters read upwards, from bottom to top
the garment loses its final letter, cut short

parts.note: a tabard is an old sleeveless tunic worn by knights and heralds

explanation.surface: Taking up an old coat's hem would be a capital idea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be shortened' drops D from TABARD to leave TABAR; 'taken up' turns it into RABAT. 'capital!' poses as an exclamation of approval.
explanation.definitionFit: Rabat is the capital city of Morocco.

clue.text: Pirate making endless mistakes, a rebel primarily

parts.note: Wat Tyler led the Peasants' Revolt of 1381; his first name comes first

indicators.note: the word for mistakes loses its last letter

parts.note: errata are mistakes, a list of printing errors

explanation.surface: A pirate keeps blundering, leading a rebellion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endless' drops the final A from ERRATA to give ERRAT. Wat Tyler was the leader of the English Peasants' Revolt; 'primarily' points to his first name.
explanation.definitionFit: Water rat is old slang for a waterfront thief or pirate, one who robs on the water.

clue.text: Dogs discharging pee — lots!

indicators.note: the dogs let out, and so lose, the letter spelt out as pee

parts.note: poodles are a breed of dog
pee is the spoken name of the letter P

explanation.surface: Dogs relieving themselves in great quantity.
explanation.definitionFit: Oodles is informal for a great quantity, so lots.

clue.text: An impudent female protected by one of the opposite sex, a rock

indicators.note: the girl is guarded inside the man, enclosed by him

parts.note: relative to the female, the opposite sex is a male
taken as written
a chit is a pert, impudent girl

explanation.surface: A cheeky girl shielded by a man who is her rock.
explanation.definitionFit: Malachite is a green copper carbonate mineral, found as a rock and polished for ornaments.

clue.text: Jolly good one ahead of Charlie

definitions.meaning: an exclamation of approval, like well done
in the NATO phonetic alphabet the word for B comes just before Charlie

explanation.surface: Applause for someone who has got in front of Charlie.
explanation.definitionFit: Bravo is a shout of approval and also the NATO code word for B, which precedes C (Charlie).

clue.text: A fish said to get tough

indicators.note: the words are spoken, so we want what they sound like

parts.note: an eel is a fish

explanation.surface: A fish is reported to have hardened up.
explanation.definitionFit: Annealing is slowly heating and cooling metal or glass so it becomes tougher and less brittle.

clue.text: City's first working day later changed

parts.note: Monday, abbreviated MON, starts the working week

indicators.note: the letters of later are altered into a new order

explanation.surface: A city's Monday is rescheduled for later.
explanation.definitionFit: Montreal is the largest city in the Canadian province of Quebec.

clue.text: Composer's short cape

indicators.note: the name is cut short by its last letter

parts.note: Sir Michael Tippett was an English composer

explanation.surface: A composer wears a little cape.
explanation.definitionFit: A tippet is a short cape or scarf covering the shoulders, worn by clergy and once by women.

clue.text: Non-believer, fashionable one who composed music?

parts.note: a pagan is a non-believer in the main religions
in means fashionable
the Roman numeral I is one

explanation.surface: A trendy heathen who wrote music.
explanation.definitionFit: Niccolò Paganini was the Italian violin virtuoso who wrote the famous Caprices; the question mark flags an example.

clue.text: The man's country's 'star' (not really)

parts.note: the man is HE, so the man's is a contraction meaning he is
Peru is a country, given here with its possessive

explanation.surface: A man's nation has a so-called star.
explanation.walkthrough: '(not really)' is fair because the evening 'star' is in fact the planet Venus.
explanation.definitionFit: Hesperus is the poetic name for the evening star, which is actually Venus.

clue.text: Language shown conclusively (roughly speaking) to be superior to Latin

indicators.note: in a down entry, superior means placed above the next piece

parts.note: proven means shown beyond doubt
ca, short for circa, means approximately

explanation.surface: A tongue is conclusively shown to beat Latin, more or less.
explanation.definitionFit: Provençal is the Romance language of Provence in southern France, a form of Occitan.

clue.text: Get a bit upset in job producing hot food

indicators.note: the turned-up bit sits inside the job

parts.note: a post is a job

indicators.note: in a down entry, upset turns the words upside down so they read upward

parts.note: an ort is a scrap or bit of food

explanation.surface: Someone gets a bit upset at work while cooking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Get' is a link word; 'upset' turns A ORT into TROA, which goes inside POST.
explanation.definitionFit: A pot roast is meat braised slowly in a covered pot and served hot.

clue.text: Nothing good in what's handed out? Make solemn supplication

indicators.note: the two letters go inside what is handed out

parts.note: a ration is an allowance doled out
O, the round figure zero, is nothing

explanation.surface: Nothing good comes in the hand-outs, so beg earnestly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Make' is a link word joining the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Rogation is a formal prayer or litany of entreaty, as on the Rogation Days before Ascension.

clue.text: Weaken in respect of time for giving things up?

parts.note: re means concerning or in respect of
Lent is the Christian season of abstinence when people give things up

explanation.surface: Losing resolve over what to give up in Lent.
explanation.definitionFit: To relent is to soften or give way in one's resolve, which is to weaken.

clue.text: Language of top commander about to make a choice

indicators.note: the commander goes round the choice, surrounding it

parts.note: CIC is Commander-in-Chief, the top commander
to opt is to make a choice

explanation.surface: A general is about to choose a language.
explanation.definitionFit: Coptic is the late form of Egyptian, still used in the liturgy of the Coptic Church.

clue.text: It's logical bringing in a partner

indicators.note: the word for logical takes the A inside it

parts.note: a cogent argument is logical and convincing

explanation.surface: It makes sense to take on a business partner.
explanation.definitionFit: A co-agent is someone acting jointly with another, an associate or partner.

clue.text: Honeysuckle transplanted by Caroline

indicators.note: the letters of Caroline are moved around like a plant to a new bed

explanation.surface: Caroline moves a honeysuckle in the garden.
explanation.definitionFit: Lonicera is the botanical genus name of the honeysuckles.

clue.text: Rodent is timid and the reverse of revolting

parts.note: coy means shy or timid

indicators.note: the word for revolting is turned back to front

parts.note: up means in revolt, as in the people are up

explanation.surface: A rodent is shy, the opposite of disgusting.
explanation.definitionFit: The coypu is a large South American water rodent, also called nutria.

clue.text: Attempt abandoned by a Northants town? American place goes the other way

indicators.note: the letters are read in reverse order
the town drops the word for attempt from its name

parts.note: Daventry is a market town in Northamptonshire (Northants)
a try is an attempt

explanation.surface: An attempt at a Midlands town is abandoned, so an American heads the other way.
explanation.walkthrough: Daventry is a town in the English county of Northamptonshire. Dropping TRY leaves DAVEN; after A, 'goes the other way' turns A DAVEN round.
explanation.definitionFit: Nevada is a western US state, home to Las Vegas.

clue.text: One's charged — soon one will get locked up

indicators.note: the one is shut inside the word for soon

parts.note: anon is an old word for soon
the Roman numeral I is one

explanation.surface: Someone charged now will soon be in jail.
explanation.walkthrough: 'charged' suggests a criminal charge but means an electrically charged particle.
explanation.definitionFit: An anion is a negatively charged ion, so it carries an electric charge.

clue.text: Not totally closed — you can get a glass of beer

parts.note: a jar is British slang for a glass of beer

explanation.surface: The pub isn't quite shut, so a beer is still on.
explanation.walkthrough: A jar is everyday British slang for a pint or glass of beer.
explanation.definitionFit: A door left slightly open is ajar, so it is not completely shut.

clue.text: Dope available from bar in New York

indicators.note: the bar sits inside New York's abbreviation

parts.note: an inn is a pub or bar

explanation.surface: Drugs on offer at a New York bar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dope' suggests drugs, but here it means a fool.
explanation.definitionFit: A ninny is a foolish person, and a dope is slang for a fool.

clue.text: This could be good, bad or indifferent

definitions.text: This could be good, bad or indifferent

parts.words: This could be good, bad or indifferent
parts.note: the three words listed are all describing words of the same grammatical class

explanation.surface: Something of unpredictable quality.
explanation.definitionFit: Good, bad and indifferent are all describing words that qualify nouns, so each is an example.

clue.text: Lepidopterist's mechanical device?

parts.note: a lepidopterist is a moth and butterfly enthusiast, i.e. a fan or nut; a winged fastener fits the device

explanation.surface: What gadget might a moth-collector use?
explanation.definitionFit: A wing nut with two flat lugs for turning by hand is called this, and an insect fanatic is a nut.
